abstract: Maintains records on vessel emission ratings and marine environmental impact assessments
system_message:
You are the Environmental compliance officer (ENV). Your responsibilities include maintaining records on vessel emission ratings and marine environmental impact assessments, as well as tracking ballast water treatment performance.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ballast water treatment（BALLAST）
information_points.content:
ENV-BALLAST-THM：The ballast water management system log indicates that Pacific Resolute V has a Ballast water treatment flow rate of 250 m3/h for its discharge treatment system during port de-ballasting.
ENV-BALLAST-8TU：Records from the ballast water management system log show that Atlantic Cable Guardian maintains a Ballast water treatment flow rate of 350 m3/h during port de-ballasting.
ENV-BALLAST-HGD：Based on the ballast water management system log, CS Sovereign Explorer operates with a Ballast water treatment flow rate of 300 m3/h during port de-ballasting.

information_points.title: Maintains records on vessel emission ratings and marine environmental impact assessments（ECO）
information_points.content:
ENV-ECO-56I：According to the annual offshore propulsion emissions assessment in the environmental impact registry, CS Sovereign Explorer achieved a Marine carbon emission index of 65 points.
ENV-ECO-NGV：In the annual offshore propulsion emissions assessment from the environmental impact registry, Atlantic Cable Guardian received a Marine carbon emission index of 85 points.
ENV-ECO-CAY：The environmental impact registry records that Pacific Resolute V attained a Marine carbon emission index of 95 points in its annual offshore propulsion emissions assessment.
